project.title: Faaruun Hin Callisu
project.english_title: The Song Will Not Fall Silent
project.logline: An elderly mother in Dambi Doolloo plucks one string on her late son's dusty guitar and hears a new generation singing his melody back through the August rain.

design_intent.audience: Oromo youth and diaspora, families from Dambi Doolloo and Wallaga, and anyone who carries memory through song.
design_intent.viewing_context: Mobile phones (9:16 vertical in family WhatsApp/Telegram chats and TikTok/Reels) and desktop/festival screening (16:9 horizontal).
design_intent.target_feeling: Quiet grief turning into unbroken pride—realizing a voice can be silenced, but a song outlives the silence.

style_block: rich painterly realism, textured charcoal-and-oil animation look, dramatic warm doorway light contrasting cool blue-gray August twilight, muted earth tones, soft 35mm film grain, centered subject framing for 16:9 and 9:16 safe crop, no readable text or watermarks anywhere

character.description: elderly Oromo woman in her late sixties, deep-lined weathered face, silver-gray hair tucked under a faded cream cotton headscarf, worn dark-brown traditional dress with subtle woven border, thin weathered hands
reference_prompts: character turnaround portrait, front and three-quarter view, neutral tender expression, soft warm side light, neutral mud-wall background
medium shot seated on a low wooden stool beside an old acoustic guitar, dramatic warm doorway light

tts.style_instruction: Speak as a warm, dignified elderly Oromo mother in her late sixties. Female voice only. Slow, unhurried, quiet grief warming into gentle pride at the end. Pause naturally at punctuation.

cues.caption: sparse solo acoustic guitar underscore, slow, tender, melancholic highland folk texture, soft distant rain ambience, minimal sustained notes, no drums, no strong lead melody, room for voiceover

warm acoustic guitar underscore resolving from melancholic A minor to hopeful relative major, gentle distant wordless hum texture, soft rain ambience, tender swell then calm fade, no drums, cinematic score

shots.reason: The room when he was small: the mother and the child together in the August rain.
shots.image_prompt: wide shot of a dim mud-walled highland room in August rain, the elderly mother and her son as a child of about eight at the rain-streaked window together, the boy is a stylized painted child with short black hair and a faded blue shirt, not a portrait of any real person, low wooden stool, bright open doorway behind them
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle camera push-in, steady August rain falling outside the open doorway, soft shifting mist

narration.om: Ammas Hagayya, ilma koo. Roobni Dambi Doolloo ammallee akkuma yeroo ati xiqqaa turtee qorqorroo kana rukkuta.
narration.am: እንደገና ነሐሴ፣ ልጄ። የደምቢ ዶሎ ዝናብ ልጅ ሳለህ እንደነበረው አሁንም ጣሪያውን ይመታል።
narration.en: August again, my son. The Dambi Doolloo rain still taps this roof, the way it did when you were small.

shots.music_cue: rain ambience only, silence before guitar

shots.reason: Introduce the mother and establish the untouched guitar as the visual symbol of absence.
shots.image_prompt: centered medium shot of the elderly mother on a low wooden stool and her son, the same stylized painted boy of about eight with short black hair and a faded blue shirt, sitting beside her with a small tea glass and an old acoustic guitar, he is humming, warm doorway light, not a portrait of any real person
shots.motion_prompt: locked static camera, subtle slow breathing of the elderly woman, soft flicker of natural daylight from doorway

narration.om: Eebbisaa, gitaarri kee ammallee keenyanitti hirkatee jira. Shaayii kee dhugaa yeedalloo qabachaa, ribbii ja'aan weedduu uummataa uumta turte.
narration.am: ኤቢሳ፣ ጊታርህ አሁንም ግድግዳው ላይ ተደግፎ አለ። ሻይህን እየጠጣህ እያንጎራጎርክ በስድስት ክሮች ለሕዝብህ ዘፈን ትፈጥር ነበር።
narration.en: Eebbisaa, your guitar still leans by the wall. You would sit there humming over your tea, making fighting songs on six strings.

shots.music_cue: single soft acoustic guitar harmonic enters

shots.reason: Show his cultural legacy beyond music: as a child he is with the neighborhood children, learning to write their names.
shots.image_prompt: the same stylized painted boy of about eight with three neighborhood children of similar age sitting on the floor around a blank notebook and a stick of white chalk, the elderly mother seated just behind them, no letters and no readable text anywhere, warm dust in the doorway light, none of the children is a portrait of a real person
shots.motion_prompt: very slow horizontal drift across the guitar strings, dust floating in light

narration.om: Ati weellisaa qofa hin turre. Ijoollee ollaa qubee—afaan keenyaan barreessuu—barsiistee, maqaa isaanii akka baratan goote.
narration.am: አንተ ዘፋኝ ብቻ አልነበርክም። የሰፈሩ ልጆች ስማቸውን መጻፍ እንዲችሉ ቁቤን—የኦሮሞ ፊደላችንን—አስተማርካቸው።
narration.en: You weren't just a singer. You taught neighborhood kids Qubee—our Oromo alphabet—so they could finally spell their own names.

shots.reason: Show tangible devotion: preserving a silenced voice on an old cassette tape.
shots.image_prompt: centered overhead close-up of her thin weathered hands gently tracing a faded blank vintage cassette tape resting on a woven cloth
shots.motion_prompt: locked camera, weathered fingers slowly glide along the cassette edge

narration.om: Namoonni kaaseetii kee dhoksaatti dhaggeeffatu turan. Anis kaaseetii kee fi dabtara walaloo weedduu kee wayyaa koo keessa maree ol kaa'eera.
narration.am: ሰዎች ካሴትህን በድብቅ ያዳምጡ ነበር። እኔም አሮጌውን ካሴትህንና የዘፈን ግጥም ደብተርህን በነጠላዬ ጠቅልዬ አስቀምጬዋለሁ።
narration.en: People listened to your cassettes in secret. I still keep your old tape and notebook of lyrics folded in my shawl.

shots.reason: Connect his craft to language and ink—words that outlived the writer.
shots.image_prompt: the elderly mother and the same stylized painted boy of about eight, short black hair, faded blue shirt, he leans over an open notebook making soft blue marks that are not letters, her hand near the page, warm light, no readable text, not a portrait of any real person
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in on the aged paper and resting hand, soft dust

narration.om: Qalamni cuquliisni kee ammallee dabtara kana guutee jira. Gara magaalaa guddoo Finfinnee osoo hin deemin, 'Haadha dhiiraa hin boo'in,' jettee naaf weeddiste.
narration.am: ሰማያዊ ቀለምህ አሁንም ይህን ደብተር ሞልቶታል። ወደ ዋና ከተማዋ ፊንፊኔ ከመሄድህ በፊት 'የጀግና እናት አታልቅሺ' ብለህ ዘፈንክልኝ።
narration.en: Your blue ink still fills this notebook. Before leaving for Finfinnee, the capital, you sang to me: 'Mother of a hero, do not cry.'

shots.reason: The emotional nadir: the heavy silence of August 1996 hanging over the house.
shots.image_prompt: centered close-up profile of the elderly woman looking out a rain-blurred window into deep blue twilight, soft raindrop shadows cast across her weathered cheek
shots.motion_prompt: static locked camera, raindrops slide slowly down the dark window glass, subtle blink

narration.om: Hagayya bara sagaltamii ja'aa, rasaasni Finfinneetti sagalee kee fudhate. Halkan sanaa as, manni kun duwwaa fi callisaa ta'e.
narration.am: በነሐሴ 1996 በፊንፊኔ ጥይት ድምፅህን ነጠቀን። ከዚያች ሌሊት ጀምሮ ይህ ቤት ባዶና ጸጥ ያለ ሆነ።
narration.en: In August 1996, a bullet in Finfinnee took your voice. Ever since that night, this house has been empty and quiet.

shots.music_cue: score drops out to near-silence and rain

shots.reason: The active pivot: she breaks the silence herself instead of staying passive in grief.
shots.image_prompt: centered medium shot of the elderly woman carefully holding the old wooden guitar across her lap, warm golden rim light from the open doorway illuminating her shoulder and headscarf
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle push-in toward her and the guitar, she gently steadies the wooden neck

narration.om: Waggootaaf tuquu hin dandeenye. Halkan kana garuu callisni kun natti ulfaate. Ani weellistuu miti, ilma koo—mee sagalee tokko nan yaala.
narration.am: ለዓመታት ልነካው አልቻልኩም ነበር። ዛሬ ማታ ግን ዝምታው ከበደኝ። እኔ ዘፋኝ አይደለሁም ልጄ—እስኪ አንድ ድምፅ ልሞክር።
narration.en: For years I couldn't bear to touch it. Tonight, the quiet is too heavy. I'm no singer, my son—let me try one note.

shots.reason: Focus on the single physical gesture that reconnects past and present.
shots.image_prompt: centered macro close-up of one weathered fingertip poised on a single worn bronze guitar string over the dark soundhole, warm golden highlight on the metal string
shots.motion_prompt: locked camera, finger gently plucks one string, faint vibration

narration.om: Ribbii dulloome tokko qofa... Isaan weellisaa ajjeesan, Eebbisaa. Weedduu garuu hin ajjeesne.
narration.am: አንድ ያረጀ ክር ብቻ... ዘፋኙን ገደሉ እንጂ ኤቢሳ፣ ዘፈኑን አልገደሉም።
narration.en: Just one old string... They killed the singer, Eebbisaa. Never the song.

shots.music_cue: one A3 guitar pluck, 1.5s into the shot, rings about 2.5s

shots.reason: Land the core feeling: grief transforming into tear-bright maternal pride.
shots.image_prompt: the elderly mother in the foreground turning toward the open doorway, and in the rainy light behind her several stylized painted children singing, simple clothes, not portraits of real people, no readable text
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, gentle warm glow brightening across her eyes

narration.om: Dhaggeeffadhu, ilma koo. Balbala koo alaan ijoolleen gaafas hin dhalanne har'allee jecha ati weeddiste hunda beeku.
narration.am: ስማ ልጄ። ከበሬ ውጭ ያኔ ያልተወለዱ ልጆች ዛሬም የዘፈንከውን ስንኝ ሁሉ ያውቃሉ።
narration.en: Listen, my son. Outside my door, children who weren't even born back then still know every line you sang.

shots.music_cue: cue_part2_hope enters, warm chordal hum and rain, ducked under the voice

shots.reason: Close the proverb in Dambi Doolloo rain: the mother and the children are in the doorway, and she does not cry.
shots.image_prompt: the elderly mother in the bright doorway and the same stylized painted children standing in the August rain on the wet path, singing back toward her, not portraits of real people, no readable text
shots.motion_prompt: slow push toward the rainy doorway, rain falling, silhouettes barely moving

narration.om: Isaan dhageessaa? Rooba Dambi Doolloo keessaan sagalee kee deebisanii siif weeddisaa jiru. Halkan kana, ilma koo... ani hin boo'u.
narration.am: ትሰማቸዋለህ? በደምቢ ዶሎ ዝናብ ውስጥ ዘፈንህን መልሰው እየዘመሩልህ ነው። ዛሬ ማታ ልጄ... እኔ አላለቅስም።
narration.en: Hear them? Through the Dambi Doolloo rain, they are singing your songs right back to you. Tonight, my son... I will not cry.

shots.music_cue: hum swells in the pauses and after I will not cry
